board: Purple "QMI8658 Sensor Module Compatible with BMI160" clone board, 21 x 16.4 mm (8 pins in one row: VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, XDA, XCL, AD0, INT)
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint, LCSC). The register map comes from the QST QMI8658A datasheet: WHO_AM_I 0x05, soft reset 0xB0 to 0x60 then 0x4D = 0x80, CTRL1 0x60, and CTRL7 0x03 to enable both sensors. Data is little-endian 16-bit from 0x33 to 0x40, with the defaults set to +/-4 g (8192 LSB/g) and +/-512 dps (64 LSB/dps), and temperature = TEMP_H + TEMP_L/256. The address is 0x6A with AD0 open; the driver also tries 0x6B.
breakoutPinoutSource: Amazon listing B0C15HC6XL product photos showing the silkscreen (https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/613TlkB8tPL._SL1000_.jpg, https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61JKaErqHPL._SL1000_.jpg)
